assets.name: 01-sales-billing
assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing / ui-mockup. Create ONE premium portrait 1080x1920 ZenxPOS app screen illustration, one single marketing poster, NOT a collage of multiple posters. This time SHOW a realistic readable POS application interface with actual labeled fields, populated forms, tables and buttons, not abstract blank UI. The interface should be a large front-facing tablet-like application card filling 85 percent of width and most of the middle vertical space; very minimal perspective for legibility. No third party brands, Google Play logos, ratings, unsupported claims or watermarks. Use exactly the specified readable text and numbers, simplify secondary decorative details to keep text clean. Customer chip 'Walk-in customer'. Product table columns 'Item', 'Qty', 'Rate', 'Amount'. Rows 'Apples', '2 kg', '₹100', '₹200'; 'Milk', '1', '₹60', '₹60'; 'Rice', '1 kg', '₹90', '₹90'. A summary panel below reads 'Subtotal ₹350', 'Discount ₹20', 'Payable ₹330'. Three payment buttons 'Cash', 'UPI', 'Card'. Prominent primary button 'Checkout'. Add small barcode scanner and shopping bag graphics near outer lower corners. Readable fields and table are the main subject.
